goal: Refund/chargeback review hold sözleşmesini invoice state graph ve workspace-scoped transaction mutation'a bağlamak
rollback: Bu paketin invoice state/persistence değişikliklerini geri al; payment, invoice, document veya delivery verisini silme veya resetleme
acceptance: Refund/chargeback review is an allowed state transition from all states with a possible invoice or pending delivery
Mutation is tenant and invoice scoped and uses compare-and-set semantics
Already reviewed is idempotent; unknown or contradictory payment state does not mutate
Delivery is held and document remains private; credit note/cancellation remains an explicit accounting action
